title: Certify a degree-nine Hurwitz generating triple

source.citation: Branching data for curves up to genus 48, arXiv:1512.07657

translation.notes: The first degree-nine generating vector in the paper's `(504,156)` Hurwitz record is converted from one-based images. Element orders, product-one, transitivity, group order, and the genus-seven Riemann-Hurwitz equation are checked exactly.
